Team —

Kickoff for FY26 planning: I attached an initial playbook and a scenario template to centralize inputs. High-level goals for this thread:

- Lock top-line targets for hosted + dedicated revenue by business unit (base / upside / downside).
- Agree on 3 scenario lanes (Base / Efficiency Upside / Conservative Downside) and the key levers that move each lane.
- Surface headcount requests and key role priorities for FY26 (people tracker to follow).
- Align on QBR readout dates and ownership for the leadership summary.

Immediate asks (short turnaround):
1) By EOD Jan 18 — each owner to post 1x slide (or a sheet row) with your top-line target and 2 assumptions that would move the target +/- 20%. Use the attached scenario-templates.xlsx.
2) By Jan 20 — submit any HC asks into the shared sheet (link below).
3) Please confirm who will own the QBR slide for your area (one owner per BU).

I propose a 30-min cross-functional sync next week to align on definitions (targets, booking recognition, net revenue definition). I'll send an invite once owners confirm.

Attachments: 2026-annual-planning-playbook.pdf; scenario-templates.xlsx

Thanks — let’s start tight.

Great — thanks for the quick responses. Final clarifications and decisions to keep everyone aligned:

1) Revenue reporting: we will publish two lines in the top-level targets: (A) Contracted ARR (Dedicated + reserved) and (B) Hosted/Usage-backed revenue. Finance will own the mapping to recognition.
2) Scenario definitions (agreed):
   - Base: conservative growth assumptions, current funnel conversion, expected churn stable.
   - Efficiency Upside: conservative price elasticity gains + higher seat utilization on Dedicated (improvement from Optimize recommendations).
   - Downside: macro slowdown, slower enterprise procurement, delayed renewals (e.g., BrightWave).
3) Deadlines: targets in sheet by EOD Jan 18; final leadership readout scheduled Feb 2.
4) Owners: Sergio (targets coordination), Laura (scenario modeling + finance mapping), Monica (HC & customer movement risks), Aditya (operational sensitivity and usage assumptions).

I will send a 30-minute sync invite for Jan 14 to align definitions and confirm owners. Please surface any blockers or conflicts on timing by EOD tomorrow.
